allowed_shared_inputs: frozen numeric neuron/synapse/stimulus translation contract from this preregistration
frozen topology shapes and graph rules described textually in this preregistration
independence_contract.runner_blinding: The reference runner must not contain or load the canonical MHRN effect sizes, equivalence bounds, EVID files or historical experiment statistics. Replication classification is performed only by a separate verifier after raw reference DATA are persisted.
independence_contract.authorship_limit: The implementation remains under the same project leadership and therefore can earn only partial cross-implementation replication credit, never full independent external replication.
independence_contract.implementer: same MHRN project leadership unless an external implementation is explicitly documented later
independence_contract.credit_semantics: Because the current implementation is project-side, success can only be PARTIAL_REPLICATION. A later genuinely external implementation must use a separately registered protocol and cannot inherit full-credit status from this run.
independence_contract.automated_leakage_guard: A pre-freeze AST/text scan must reject imports from MHRN runtime modules and references to EVID-2026-19, EXP-S1-TOPO-PROMO-R1-20260927, canonical_targets, frozen_bounds, equivalence bounds, research/experiments, or research/registry/evidence from within reference/stage1_topology_brian2/.

translation_contract.integration: At each 1 ms tick, use the MHRN canonical two-half-Euler update for v followed by one Euler update for u: v += 0.5*(0.04*v^2+5*v+140-u+I), repeated twice; u += a*(b*v-u). A spike is detected after integration when v>=30, then reset v=c and u=u+d.

threshold_adaptation.rule: Spike detection uses 30.0 + threshold_adaptation. On spike, threshold_adaptation += 0.01; after firing-rate update it is multiplied by 0.999; homeostasis is then applied.

homeostasis.rule: After each tick, firing_rate_estimate is updated with alpha=1-exp(-elapsed_ms/1000); homeostasis then adds 0.001*(firing_rate_estimate-10) to threshold_adaptation and clamps it to [-10,10].

energy.rule: Energy is decremented on spikes and recovers after each tick, but Neuron.step/integrate_membrane/spike_threshold do not read energy to determine v/u or spike threshold.
energy.reference_requirement: may be omitted from the reference dynamics only if the pre-freeze source audit remains green; omission must be declared in provenance

traces.rule: Pre/post traces increment/decay but are not read by membrane integration or spike threshold in the canonical topology runner.
traces.reference_requirement: may be omitted from the reference dynamics only if the pre-freeze source audit remains green

synaptic_plasticity.rule: The topology runner creates fixed-weight Synapse objects. NeuralNetwork.step queues and delivers connection.weight but does not invoke pair-STDP, eligibility or reward updates.
synaptic_plasticity.reference_requirement: reference synaptic weights remain fixed during each run

translation_contract.synapses: Current-based excitatory events of fixed weight 55.0 with exactly one-tick delay. No plasticity during the run.
translation_contract.tick_order: For tick t: clear/read external currents; deliver events whose delivery_tick==t; combine external+synaptic current; execute two half-Euler v updates and one u Euler update; test v >= 30 + current threshold_adaptation; if spiked reset v=c,u+=d and add threshold_adaptation_rate; update firing-rate estimate; decay threshold adaptation; apply homeostasis; queue outgoing fixed-weight events for t+delay. Energy/traces may update as audited but are spike-timing inert.
translation_contract.stimulus: At tick 0 only, inject current 100.0 into logical labels 0,1,2,3.

topology_generation.coordinate_order: canonical lexicographic product order of the declared 5D shape
topology_generation.geometric_rule: For each source label, connect to the up to four future labels with smallest normalized Euclidean coordinate distance; ties are resolved by a frozen seed-derived deterministic tie key, then label.
topology_generation.5d_shuffled: Shuffle coordinate-to-label assignment using the frozen reference implementation's independently specified deterministic PRNG mapping before applying the same geometric edge rule.
topology_generation.random_graph: For each source, choose the same number of future targets uniformly without replacement using the frozen reference PRNG mapping.

metric_translation.active_neuron: a neuron that emitted at least one spike by the end of the evaluated tick
metric_translation.final_active_fraction: number of ever-active neurons divided by 64
metric_translation.activation_auc_0_32: sum of cumulative ever-active-neuron fraction over ticks 0..31 inclusive
metric_translation.first_output_latency_censored: first tick with any spike from labels 60..63; if absent use the frozen censor sentinel 129
metric_translation.delivered_events: count of synaptic spike events delivered to postsynaptic neurons
metric_translation.total_spikes: total emitted spikes across all neurons

translation_contract.deviation_policy: Any discovered semantic mismatch that could change spike timing, event delivery or registered endpoints blocks execution and requires a new preregistration revision before reference DATA are generated.

evaluation.seed_selection_rationale: The originally drafted block 1200021-1200040 failed the executable freshness gate because seed 1200035 already existed in historical Batch artifacts. Before any reference DATA and before freeze, the entire block was discarded. The replacement block 810000001-810000020 was selected as a new contiguous bookkeeping block and returned no repository-search matches at selection time; the executable freshness gate must still pass at the exact freeze commit.
evaluation.primary_test: exact two-sided paired sign test within reference DATA
evaluation.primary_multiple_testing: one Holm family across the five first-output-latency contrasts
evaluation.effect_interval: deterministic paired bootstrap 95% CI for median difference
evaluation.secondary_role: activation_auc_0_32 direction is a secondary concordance check and cannot rescue failed primary replication criteria

seed_revision_history.reason: Executable pre-freeze freshness gate found historical collision for 1200035 in EXP-BATCH-20260914074039-77 artifacts.
seed_revision_history.action: Discarded the entire block before freeze and before any reference evaluation; no outcomes existed or were inspected.

canonical_targets.equivalence_bounds_rule: Strict sign-preserving equivalence fixed at 50%-150% of the absolute canonical median effect for every primary latency contrast. No resolution-based widening is used.
canonical_targets.direction_rule: Every partial-replication primary contrast must retain the canonical non-zero sign and its median must lie inside the frozen 50%-150% equivalence interval. For 3d->5d this means median <0 and within [-1.5,-0.5].
canonical_targets.resolution_note: The primary latency metric is discrete and paired medians with n=20 can occur in 0.5-tick increments. This discreteness is treated as a known sensitivity limitation, not as grounds to widen the equivalence interval. A Brian2 median of -2.0 for 3d->5d is outside the preregistered equivalence bound.

criterion_revision_history.change: A temporary DRAFT considered widening 3d->5d from [-1.5,-0.5] to [-2.0,-0.5] for metric discreteness.
criterion_revision_history.resolution: Withdrawn after methodological review before any Brian2 reference evaluation DATA existed. Canonical freeze candidate restored the original strict 50%-150% interval [-1.5,-0.5].

partial_replication: all five first-output-latency reference contrasts retain the canonical direction
all five reference median deltas lie inside their frozen equivalence bounds
all five primary paired sign tests remain Holm-significant with bootstrap CI excluding zero
at least four of five activation_auc_0_32 secondary contrast directions agree with the canonical direction
failed_replication: any primary latency contrast reverses canonical direction
or two or more primary latency contrasts have median effects outside the frozen equivalence bounds and their 95% bootstrap CIs are wholly outside those bounds
or fewer than three of five primary latency contrasts are Holm-significant
inconclusive: a semantic translation mismatch is discovered after freeze
or one or more primary latency CIs span an equivalence boundary such that success/failure classification is unstable
or exactly three or four primary contrasts satisfy both Holm significance and equivalence while none reverse direction
or exactly one primary contrast is wholly outside its equivalence bound without direction reversal while the remaining four satisfy the primary criteria
or reference runtime behavior makes a preregistered endpoint non-comparable
decision_rule.equal_value_rule: PARTIAL_REPLICATION, FAILED_REPLICATION and INCONCLUSIVE_REFERENCE_REPLICATION are equally reportable scientific outcomes. No secondary endpoint or post-hoc tuning may rescue a failed primary classification.

maturity_semantics.success: A successful reference replication counts only as partial independent/reference replication = 7.5/15 points, advancing Stage-1 maturity from 85% to 92.5%.
maturity_semantics.failure: A failed or inconclusive reference replication does not increase maturity and must remain visible in the canonical Stage-1 state.
maturity_semantics.full_credit: 15/15 replication credit remains reserved for genuinely external, independently controlled/authored replication.

integrator_parity.protocol: one neuron, one tick, current=0 and current=100; compare MHRN and Brian2 final v,u, threshold_adaptation, firing_rate_estimate, spike flag
integrator_parity.pass_rule: all compared scalar fields match within 1e-12 and spike flags are identical in both cases
integrator_parity.failure_rule: freeze blocked; no reference evaluation may run

mechanism_audit.pass_rule: every spike-timing-relevant canonical mechanism is classified and translated; every omitted mechanism is source-demonstrated spike-timing inert

runner_independence_scan.pass_rule: no forbidden MHRN imports, EVID/experiment access, canonical target/equivalence access, or research artifact reads in the reference runner package

seed_freshness.pass_rule: All evaluation seeds are absent from every other tracked file at freeze. Their only allowed pre-execution declarations are the canonical preregistration and the sanitized Brian2 runner protocol; the later freeze record may duplicate them as provenance.
seed_freshness.failure_rule: select a new seed block before freeze

reset_parity.protocol: one neuron, forced spike followed by the next tick; compare spike flag, reset v=c, u increment by d, threshold adaptation, firing-rate estimate and next-tick state
reset_parity.pass_rule: all compared state fields and spike decisions match MHRN within 1e-12

synapse_delay_parity.protocol: two neurons, one fixed excitatory synapse weight 55 and delay 1 tick; induce a source spike at tick 0 and compare event delivery tick, delivered-event count, postsynaptic current/state and spike decision
synapse_delay_parity.pass_rule: event is absent at source-spike tick, delivered exactly one tick later, and compared target state/spike fields match MHRN within 1e-12

integrated_requirements: one-neuron one-tick integrator parity before freeze
resolution-aware integer-tick equivalence bounds fixed before DATA
complete PARTIAL_REPLICATION / FAILED_REPLICATION / INCONCLUSIVE_REFERENCE_REPLICATION decision rules

freeze_semantics: Scientific translation, targets, equivalence bounds, endpoints and decision criteria are frozen. Reference evaluation remains forbidden until a separately reviewed runner implementation is hash-bound and explicitly authorized.

integrator_parity.rule: PASS required before freeze. Single-tick subthreshold cases must match v/u/adaptation/firing-rate state at absolute tolerance 1e-12; multi-tick case must include at least one spike and match the same state plus spike decisions at every tick.

mechanism_audit.rule: Threshold adaptation and homeostasis are timing-relevant and must be translated. Energy and traces may be omitted only as explicitly audited causally inert state for registered propagation endpoints.

independence_scan.rule: Reference package must have no imports from src/, research/, or Stage-1 MHRN runner modules and must not contain canonical EVID/experiment identifiers or frozen target-table labels.

seed_freshness.rule: Evaluation seeds 810000001-810000020 must be rechecked automatically at the freeze commit; any occurrence outside the preregistration and blinded reference_protocol.json blocks freeze.

reference_implementation_authorship.classification_consequence: Even if a separate framework/codebase is used, this project-side implementation is PARTIAL_REPLICATION only. It cannot be relabeled EXTERNAL_REPLICATION without genuinely external authorship/control and a separately registered protocol.

freeze_authorization.rule: Freeze is allowed only after mechanism audit, single/multi-tick integrator parity, explicit reset parity, synapse-delay parity, independence scan and seed freshness all pass and are source-bound.
